entities.name: STAT3
aliases: signal transducer and activator of transcription 3

relationships.subject: YY1
relationships.evidence_quote: YY1 increased the expression of suppressor of cytokine signaling 3 (SOCS3)

relationships.subject: YY1
relationships.evidence_quote: YY1 overexpression promoted SOCS3 expression, increased cell proliferation and suppressed cell apoptosis, and reduced the activation of STAT3

relationships.subject: SOCS3
relationships.evidence_quote: blockade of SOCS3 by SOCS3‑antibody abrogated the effect of YY1 overexpression on the suppression of SOCS3‑mediated STAT3 activation and inflammation

relationships.subject: YY1
relationships.evidence_quote: YY1 reduced rat mechanical allodynia, thermal hyperalgesia and cold hyperalgesia in a dose‑dependent manner

relationships.subject: STAT3
relationships.evidence_quote: suppressed signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3)‑mediated production of inflammatory factors in a dose‑dependent manner

key_findings: YY1 mRNA is decreased in spinal cord of bCCI rats; intrathecal YY1 overexpression dose-dependently reduced mechanical allodynia, thermal and cold hyperalgesia.
YY1 upregulates SOCS3, which suppresses STAT3 activation and STAT3-mediated inflammatory factor production.
